title: Swarm
description: The agent swarm's housekeeping: who is ticking, what is locked, queued, in review and overdue. Metrics from getcouchy/swarm's sweep.mjs and reviewed.mjs (docs/metrics.md there); this file is charts/swarm/dashboards/swarm.json in that repository.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: The namespace the chart's CronJobs run in, found from kube-state-metrics by the agent-sweep CronJob. It scopes the failed runs and the log panel.

list.name: item
list.label: Item
list.description: A work item's key (COUCHYUX-34) or a pull request's number, for the Item timeline.

list.name: plane
list.label: Plane
list.description: Plane's web origin and workspace, which work item links open under.

panels.title: Since each agent last ticked

targets.expr: time() - (max by (agent) (tick_run_last_start_timestamp_seconds{agent=~"$agent"} and on (agent) tick_info{repo="$repository"}) or on (agent) max by (agent) (swarm_agent_last_tick_timestamp_seconds{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}))

panels.description: From the start of each agent's last run, as its tick runner reports it, or from its heartbeat comment on the Agent desk for an agent no runner reports. The colours assume the default 8 hour limit; the panel beside this one draws the limit the sweep ran with.

panels.title: Since last tick, against the limit

targets.expr: time() - (max by (agent) (tick_run_last_start_timestamp_seconds{agent=~"$agent"} and on (agent) tick_info{repo="$repository"}) or on (agent) max by (agent) (swarm_agent_last_tick_timestamp_seconds{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}))

panels.title: Locks held

targets.expr: count by (agent) (tick_lock_held_timestamp_seconds{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}) or (count by (agent) (swarm_lock_age_seconds{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}) unless on (agent) tick_github_rate_limit_remaining)

panels.description: Locks each agent holds: live from its tick runner, or from the swarm/agent/<name> labels the sweep reads for an agent no runner reports.

panels.title: Locks

targets.expr: sum by (type, number, agent) (time() - tick_lock_held_timestamp_seconds{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}) or sum by (type, number, agent) (swarm_lock_age_seconds{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"} unless on (agent) tick_github_rate_limit_remaining)

panels.description: From each agent's tick runner, which knows the second a lock is taken and released, or from the sweep's swarm/agent/<name> labels for an agent no runner reports.

panels.title: On now

targets.expr: sum by (agent, task, type, number) (time() - tick_job_started_timestamp_seconds{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"})

panels.description: The job each agent's tick runner has in flight, from agent.mjs's events. Empty for an agent no runner reports.

panels.title: Last run

targets.expr: sum by (agent, task, type, number) (tick_run_last_job_seconds{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"})

panels.description: The jobs of each agent's last finished run, and how long each took.

panels.title: Worked on

targets.expr: sum by (repo, item, type) (sum_over_time({service="tick-runner", agent=~"$agent"} |= `{"tick_item":` | json | __error__="" | repo="$repository" | tick_item="finished" | unwrap seconds | __error__="" [$__range]))

max by (repo, item, type, url) (max_over_time({service="tick-runner", agent=~"$agent"} |= `{"tick_item":` | json | __error__="" | repo="$repository" | label_format url=`{{ if .key }}$plane/browse/{{ .key }}/{{ else }}https://github.com/{{ .repo }}/pull/{{ .item }}{{ end }}` | label_format at_s=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap at_s | __error__="" [$__range])) * 1000

topk by (repo, item, type) (1, max by (repo, item, type, title) (max_over_time({service="tick-runner", agent=~"$agent"} |= `{"tick_item":` | json | __error__="" | repo="$repository" | title!="" | label_format at_s=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap at_s | __error__="" [$__range])))
count by (repo, item, type, agent) (count_over_time({service="tick-runner", agent=~"$agent"} |= `{"tick_item":` | json | __error__="" | repo="$repository" [$__range]))
count by (repo, item, type, task) (count_over_time({service="tick-runner", agent=~"$agent"} |= `{"tick_item":` | json | __error__="" | repo="$repository" | task!="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Each work item and pull request the agents' tick runners touched in this time range, from their item log lines in Loki: the latest title, who, which jobs, the time their finished jobs took, and the last thing that happened to it. An item only claimed or handed off has no time spent. A work item opens in Plane, a pull request on GitHub.

panels.title: Item timeline
panels.description: Everything any agent's tick runner did to the item named in the Item box above, oldest first. Empty while the box is.

targets.expr: {service="tick-runner"} |= `{"tick_item":` | json | __error__="" | repo="$repository" | label_format hash_item=`#{{ .item }}` | (hash_item=~"(?i)#?${item:regex}" or (work_item!="" and work_item=~"(?i)${item:regex}")) | line_format `{{ printf "%-10s" .agent }} {{ printf "%-11s" .tick_item }} {{ if .key }}{{ .key }}{{ else }}#{{ .item }}{{ end }}{{ if .title }} {{ .title }}{{ end }}{{ if .task }}  [{{ .task }}]{{ end }}{{ if .work_item }}  for {{ .work_item }}{{ end }}{{ if .pulls }}  PRs {{ .pulls }}{{ end }}{{ if .seconds }}  {{ div .seconds 60 }}m{{ mod .seconds 60 }}s{{ end }}`

panels.title: Agent log
panels.description: Every line the chosen agents' tick containers wrote in this time range, oldest first: the runner's own lines as written, item lines rewritten to read like the Item timeline. One agent over the span of a run is that run.

targets.expr: {service="tick-runner", agent=~"$agent"} | json | line_format `{{ if .tick_item }}{{ printf "%-10s" .agent }} {{ printf "%-11s" .tick_item }} {{ if .key }}{{ .key }}{{ else }}{{ .repo }}#{{ .item }}{{ end }}{{ if .title }} {{ .title }}{{ end }}{{ if .task }}  [{{ .task }}]{{ end }}{{ if .work_item }}  for {{ .work_item }}{{ end }}{{ if .pulls }}  PRs {{ .pulls }}{{ end }}{{ if .seconds }}  {{ div .seconds 60 }}m{{ mod .seconds 60 }}s{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}` | drop __error__, __error_details__

panels.title: Approved issues
panels.description: Claimable: approved and nobody has taken it. Blockers are not looked up, so a blocked issue counts as claimable.

panels.title: The reviewed status
panels.description: The required `reviewed` status on each open pull request's head.

panels.title: Overdue by kind
panels.description: What the Agent desk lists, by section. docs/metrics.md in getcouchy/swarm says what each kind is.

panels.title: Handed to a person, per hour

targets.expr: sum by (agent, type) (increase(tick_handoffs_total{kind="needs_human", repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}[1h])) or (sum by (agent, type) (increase(swarm_needs_human_total{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}[1h])) unless on (agent) tick_handoffs_total)

panels.description: Times swarm/needs-human went onto an issue or pull request, by the agent it was with. An agent's tick runner counts its handoffs as it makes them; the sweep's count is used only for an agent whose runner does not, since both count the same handoff.

panels.title: Held from merging, per hour

targets.expr: sum by (agent) (increase(tick_handoffs_total{kind="hold", repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}[1h])) or (sum by (agent) (increase(swarm_hold_total{repository="$repository", agent=~"$agent"}[1h])) unless on (agent) tick_handoffs_total)

panels.description: Times swarm/hold went onto a pull request. From the agent's tick runner where it counts handoffs, else from the sweep; never both.

panels.title: Failed job runs
panels.description: Failed Jobs still kept in the namespace, from kube-state-metrics. This is every CronJob in it, not only the two that push metrics.

panels.title: GitHub API requests left
panels.description: Left in the App token's hour after each run.

panels.title: Fixed by the sweep, per run
Runs by status, per hour

targets.expr: sum by (agent, status) (increase(tick_runs_total{agent=~"$agent"}[1h]) and on (agent) tick_info{repo="$repository"})

panels.description: Runs each agent's tick runner finished, by how they ended (getcouchy/agent-runner's tick_runs_total).

panels.title: Runs in flight
panels.description: Running from the runner's start push until its end push. One left running past the timeout is a run whose container died.

panels.title: What the sweep fixed and found overdue
panels.description: The sweep's own log lines, one for each fix and each overdue item at every run: what its comments on the Agent desk said.
